name: Workbox prepared host
description: Prepare a connected Linux server for Workbox sandboxes: install the daemon, filesystem and runtime, then connect its private API automatically.

features.title: Automatic preparation
features.description: Check the server, install the pinned Workbox daemon and build its filesystem and runtime.

features.title: Private connection
features.description: Keep the API on loopback and reach it through the server's existing authenticated SSH connection.

features.title: Managed lifecycle
features.description: Follow installation progress, retry interrupted preparation and manage the host alongside its sandbox connection.
